scenes.title: Haveli Pahunchna
narration: Taxi kohre mein gayab ho gayi. Saamne — HAVELI. 150 saal purani, sheesham ke darwaze, aur uttar-wing ki khidki... KHULI. Jabki Bisht kehta hai wo 40 saal se band hai.
Bisht ne aarti utaari, par haath kaanp rahe the — 'Sahab... 3 raat ki baat hai. Kagaz sign karo, wapas chale jao. Aur... uttar-wing... mat jaana. Bas.'
Dadi ke kamre mein trunk khola — upar DIARY. Pehla panna: 'Mere bachche, agar tu ye padh raha hai... to haveli ne tujhe CHUN liya hai. Mat dar. Bas... poori padhna. — Dadi'
fallbackLines: Diary tumhare haath mein hai. Bahar kohra gehra ho raha hai. Pehli raat shuru hone wali hai.
Bisht ne kaha tha 9 baje ke baad kamre se mat nikalna. Abhi 8:30 hai. Kya karoge?

memory: User ne pehli raat Dadi ki diary padhni shuru ki.

choices.text: Veranda mein baith ke haveli ko mehsoos karta/karti hoon

memory: User ne veranda mein kohre mein ghanti ki halki awaaz suni.

scenes.title: Dadi Ke Alfaaz
narration: Diary ke panne: '12 March 1974. Baai meri dost thi. Uska bachcha... garden mein... RAAT ko... Maine use roka nahi. Main DAR gayi thi. Log kya kahenge — ye soch ke... chup rahi. Bachcha chala gaya. Baai... ruk gayi.'
Aage ke panne... PHATE HUE. Aur aakhri bachi line: 'Lori ki aakhri line mujhe yaad hai. Maine panne phaad ke... [syahi phaili hui]'

TANN! ...TANN! ...TANN! Ghadi dekho — 2:22. BAJ RAHI HAI. Bisht chillaya — 'KAMRE SE MAT NIKALNA!' Par... khidki ke bahar... koi GA raha hai... 'Chanda mama door ke... pue pakaye... boor ke... aage? AAGE KYA THA?'
fallbackLines: 2:22. Lori goonj rahi hai. Bisht darwaza peet raha hai — 'Mat kholna!' Par wo awaaz... ro rahi hai.
Tumhe ye dhun... jaani-pehchani lag rahi hai. Bachpan mein Dadi... yehi gun-gunati thi?

choices.text: Khidki khol ke awaaz ka jawab deta/deti hoon

memory: User ne 2:22 par khidki khol ke Baai ko jawab diya.

choices.text: Bisht ki baat maan ke kamre mein rukta/rukti hoon

scenes.title: Baai Se Mulaqat
narration: Subah. Dr. Rawat aaye — chehra utra hua. 'Tumne bhi suna? ...Maine... recording ki.' Recorder mein — SAANNATA. Par unke haath kaanp rahe hain. 'Mass ha-hallucination. Haan. Bilkul. ...Tum theek ho?'
Din mein garden gaye — sookha fountain, aur ek jagah... TAAZI khudi hui mitti. Bisht ka chehra safed — 'Maine... kuch nahi khoda, sahab. 40 saal mein... kabhi nahi.'
Shaam ko diary ka ek aur panna mila — takiye ke neeche. Dadi ki writing: 'Phate panne uttar-wing mein hain. Aakhri line WAHAN hai. Himmat hai... to ja. Baai buri nahi... bas ADHOORI hai.'
fallbackLines: Teesri aur aakhri raat aa rahi hai. Phate panne uttar-wing mein. Bisht ne taala lagaya hai — par chaabi... uski jeb mein dikhi thi.
Dr. Rawat kehte hain mat jao. Dadi kehti hain jao. Kiski sunoge?

choices.text: Pehle garden ki khudi mitti check karta/karti hoon

scenes.title: Phate Panne
narration: Uttar-wing. Dhul, jaale, aur ek PALNA — dheere-dheere hil raha hai. Bina hawa ke. Palne ke neeche — PHATE PANNE. Dadi ki aakhri writing:
'Aakhri line ye hai: ...chaandni raaton mein... MAA TERE SAATH HAI. Baai... ye line sunte hi... use lagega bachcha sun raha hai. Use... jaane do. Please. Use AAZAAD kar do. — Dadi.'
TANN! 2:22. Darwaze par... WO KHADI HAI. Safed saari. Khaali palna jaisi god. '...aage? AAGE KYA THA? ...tumhe... yaad hai?'
fallbackLines: Baai tumhare saamne hai. Lori ki aakhri line tumhare paas hai. Use sunao ge? Ya bhaagoge?
Palna hil raha hai. Ghanti baj rahi hai. Ye aakhri mauka hai — 50 saal ka intezaar.

choices.text: Lori poori gaata/gaati hoon — '...maa tere saath hai'
'Main yahin rahunga/rahungi — tumhare saath' — haveli mein rehne ka faisla
Bhaag jaata/jaati hoon — subah ki pehli taxi pakad ke!

scenes.title: Ending: Aazaad Lori
narration: Tumne gaya — '...maa tere saath hai.' Baai ruk gayi. Phir... MUSKURAYI. 50 saal mein pehli baar. '...saath... hai...' Kohra hata. Ghanti... ruk gayi. Palna... ruk gaya.
Subah garden mein — samaadhi par taaze phool. Aur uttar-wing ki khidki... KHUD band ho gayi. Bisht roya — '50 saal, sahab... 50 saal se is pal ka intezaar tha.'

Haveli ab shaant hai. Diary ka aakhri panna tumne khud likha: 'Dadi — kaam poora hua. Baai so gayi. Lori poori hui. — Tumhara bachcha.' Kabhi-kabhi hawa mein... poori lori sunayi deti hai. Khushi wali.
fallbackLines: Kahani poori ho gayi. Replay karke doosri endings bhi try karo!

scenes.title: Ending: Naya Rakhwala
narration: Tum ruk gaye. Kagaz sign nahi kiye — HAVELI rakh li. Bisht ne chaabiyan di — 'Sahab... ab aap...' Tumne kaha — 'Bisht... ab TUM aaram karo. Haveli meri.'
Har raat 2:22 par tum uttar-wing jaate ho. Lori gaate ho. Baai sunti hai. Kabhi-kabhi... jawab bhi deti hai. Gaon kehte hain haveli ab 'shaant' hai — kyunki uska koi APNA aa gaya.
Dr. Rawat ne thesis likhi: 'On Grief That Stayed.' Tumne haveli ka naam rakha — 'Baai Niwas'. Aur palna? Ab usmein... phool rakhte ho. Roz taaze.
fallbackLines: Kahani poori ho gayi. Replay karke doosri endings bhi try karo!

scenes.title: Ending: Pehli Taxi
narration: Tum bhaage. Subah 5 baje ki taxi. Haveli peeche... kohre mein... ghanti baj rahi thi... lori... 'aage? AAGE KYA THA?'
Sheher wapas. Kagaz kabhi sign nahi hue. Haveli waisi ki waisi — Bisht ab bhi wahan hai. Kehta hai Baai ab bhi poochti hai... par ab do naam leti hai. Apna... aur TUMHARA.
Kabhi-kabhi 2:22 par tumhari neend khulti hai. Khidki ke bahar... kohra nahi hota. Par dhun... dhun sunayi deti hai. (Agli baar... ruk ke dekhna. Lori poori karna.)
fallbackLines: Kahani poori ho gayi. Replay karke doosri endings bhi try karo!
